M-TOOL.Purpose: Tool extension contract: the abstract Tool class with lifecycle hooks and the [Tool(id)] registration attribute every FlexTools tool implements.

Scope.SCP-IN-002: ToolAttribute: id and IsEnabledByDefault. Discovery and lifecycle management — owned by M-TOOL-MANAGER.

Requirements.REQ-001: Every concrete tool is registered exactly by its [Tool(id)] identity.

Inputs.IN-001: id: string — stable tool identity in settings and UI.

Outputs.OUT-001: Tool.Initialize / Tool.Shutdown lifecycle invocations driven by M-TOOL-MANAGER.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Concrete tool implementations may perform arbitrary side effects in their hooks.
